# Charmed Family Salon

> Unisex hair, beauty and bridal salon in Garia, Kolkata, India, for men, women and kids. Open every day, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Rated 4.8 out of 5 on Google from 324+ reviews. Established 2025.

Last updated: 7 October 2026.

## Quick facts

- Name: Charmed Family Salon (also known as Charmed Unisex Salon)
- Type: Unisex salon: hair, grooming, skin care, makeup and bridal
- Address: 259, Anandapally Lane, Mahamaya Tala, Garia, Kolkata 700084, West Bengal, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89819 65553
- Email: info@charmedfamilysalon.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM (open every day)
- Google rating: 4.8 / 5 from 324+ reviews
- Booking: WhatsApp or phone; walk-ins welcome subject to availability
- New clients: 10% off the first visit (mention it when booking)
- Full price list: https://charmedfamilysalon.com/services.html

## Prices (official price list, October 2026)

Prices in Indian rupees. Hair prices may vary with the density and length of the hair.

- Haircut, men: ₹200 (creative), ₹250 (advanced)
- Haircut, women: ₹300 (creative), ₹450 (advanced)
- Haircut, children: ₹200 (boys), ₹300 (girls)
- Shave ₹100 · beard trim ₹100 · head shave ₹300 · beard colour ₹300
- Men's global hair colour: ₹800 to ₹1,000 · men's highlights ₹1,500
- Women's global hair colour ₹2,500 · root touch-up ₹1,000 to ₹1,300 · full-head highlights ₹2,500 · ombre ₹5,000 · balayage ₹5,500
- Keratin ₹4,500 · hair botox ₹5,000 · nanoplastia ₹5,500
- Re-bonding / smoothening: ₹4,500 (fine hair), ₹5,000 (thick hair) · straightening ₹4,500
- Olaplex ₹1,500 · anti-dandruff ₹1,000 · anti-hair-loss ₹1,000 · molecular treatment ₹2,000
- Hair spa: men ₹500 to ₹1,500, women ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 (by brand: Matrix, L'Oréal, Frenzy Follicles, Keratin, Macadamia)
- Clean-up ₹700 to ₹800 · basic facial ₹1,000 · advanced facials ₹1,500 to ₹3,000 · premium facials ₹3,000 to ₹5,500
- D-tan: face ₹500 to ₹700 · body polishing ₹3,500
- Manicure / pedicure: express ₹500, deluxe ₹750, premium ₹1,500
- Strip wax: half legs ₹450, full legs ₹800, full arms ₹600, back ₹800
- Threading: eyebrows ₹40, upper lip ₹30, full face ₹300
- Bridal makeup (non-HD) ₹10,000 · party makeup ₹1,500 · HD party makeup ₹4,500 · saree draping with hair styling and make-up ₹2,500
- Head massage ₹400 · foot massage ₹300 · back massage ₹200

## Services

- Men: haircuts, beard trim and styling, shave, head shave, beard and moustache colour, hair colour and highlights, hair spa, head massage
- Women: haircuts, global colour, root touch-up, highlights, ombre, balayage, keratin, hair botox, nanoplastia, smoothening and re-bonding, Olaplex, scalp treatments, hair spa
- Skin and beauty: clean-up, facials, D-tan, body polishing, manicure, pedicure, waxing, threading
- Makeup and bridal: bridal makeup, party and HD party makeup, saree draping and hair styling
- Kids: haircuts for boys and girls

## Areas served

The salon is in Garia (Mahamaya Tala). Clients come from Garia, Sonarpur, Boral, Narendrapur, Baghajatin, Patuli, Mukundapur, Santoshpur, Bansdroni, Regent Park, Jadavpur, Kamalgazi and across South Kolkata.

## Frequently asked questions

**Where is Charmed Family Salon?**
259, Anandapally Lane, Mahamaya Tala, Garia, Kolkata 700084.

**What are the opening hours?**
Every day, Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

**How much is a haircut?**
Men ₹200 to ₹250, women ₹300 to ₹450, children ₹200 to ₹300.

**How much is keratin treatment?**
Keratin is ₹4,500, hair botox ₹5,000 and nanoplastia ₹5,500. The price may vary with hair density and length.

**How do I book?**
WhatsApp or call +91 89819 65553. Walk-ins are welcome subject to availability.

**Is it a unisex salon?**
Yes. Men, women and kids are all served at the same salon.
